interpretation: Public GitHub-hosted Fast Shadow had a healthy fresh feed on the same main SHA while the private V6 market-discovery path was unhealthy. This supports classifying the private zero-activity snapshot as a runtime/proxy/data-path defect rather than market inactivity. next_fast_arb_requirement: Broaden research coverage only together with per-token receive/exchange timestamps, bounded leg age/skew, multi-level depth, verified fees, sequential legging and unwind; do not infer alpha from healthy feed status alone.
